name: @dsor-steps/mj-35-a-fake-bank
description: Step 35 of the DSoR baby steps, a learner build: a fake bank. A second connector, a pretend bank with switches for good, slow, broken, and silent, which refuses a repeated key and answers whether a payment went through. payment.execute, the first command that cannot be undone, is routed only to a bank that declares one of the two (DSOR-UNK-03a), and DSoR hands the bank a key derived from the proposal (DSOR-IDM-03). A silent bank is reported as OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, never as success or failure.
